method: Descriptive extraction with source cells. No fitted potency, new p-values, pooled biological n, or missing-value imputation.

cell_imaging_context.selected_clones: The article selected one MTM1-null clone after observing clone heterogeneity and impaired myogenesis even in nontargeting controls.
cell_imaging_context.timing: Compound added after 72 hours of differentiation, then imaged after a further 48 hours. This is treatment during differentiation, not pretreatment from differentiation day zero and not established mature-force reversal.
cell_imaging_context.reported_repetition: Figure3 calls B-E representative quantification from three independent experiments; B-G use five random nonoverlapping fields and report n=10. Complete experiment/well/field identifiers are absent from these source sheets.
cell_imaging_context.inference_unit: Ten reported values per group cannot be relabeled ten independent cultures, donors or experiments.
cell_imaging_context.asterisks: Numeric strings bearing an asterisk are retained. An unmarked-only mean is a descriptive sensitivity calculation, not an authorized exclusion.
cell_imaging_context.endpoint: Fusion index, nuclei per MYH-positive structure and structure count are morphology. They do not measure twitch force, tetanic force, fatigue or respiratory performance.
cell_imaging_context.S2_context: S2 is target-depleted MTM1-null cells. Its baseline is not a WT normalization denominator for Figure3.
cell_imaging_context.cross_panel_linkage: Row positions alone do not establish matched images or experimental blocks across panels; no cross-panel product, paired test or shared baseline is computed.

target_depleted_imaging.model: PIK3C2B-depleted MTM1-null C2C12 cells; source caption, not healthy WT

lipidomic_context.model: PIK3C3/VPS34-KO and PIK3C3-WT C2C12 cells, each with or without 1 micromolar PIK3C2B inhibitor
lipidomic_context.context_consistency: The PIK3C3 labels in Fig5E are consistent with the article caption, Results and Methods. They are not a labeling discrepancy.
lipidomic_context.separate_from: Figure5A-D proteomics/phosphoproteomics uses MTM1-null mouse muscle with versus without constitutive PIK3C2B kinase inactivation.
lipidomic_context.multiplicity: Figure5F reports significance at P<0.05 and this sheet contains p.value columns without adjusted q-value columns. No new multiplicity correction is asserted.
lipidomic_context.interpretation: This separate lipid-kinase perturbation experiment cannot be presented as direct lipidomic normalization of MTM1-null human muscle by BLU3797, nor as a validated functional-response biomarker.
